translation: Thus Kanesh, say to Ali-ahum: Why is it that you have not paid in accordance with our father's house and we seized him as follows: "I shall come back."
To Ali-ahum from the City of Umum. Witnessed by Damiq-pī-Aššur in accordance with U<gap>

From Mupping to Taameni: Why is it that you wrote me about, and I have not paid in accordance with our father's customers, if he doesn't settle him as follows: "I shall stay against my silver." Luptanum brought us a tablet which Iddin-abum, says Ali-ahum.
From <gap> to Karuma and Wabarratum; sealed by the merchant. They will add interest accounts for my silver as well.
